## Notes

Infobox and lead date the Intellivision release to 1982-06-03 (Aquarius port 1983) although the article title says 1981; Mattel Electronics, designed and programmed by Don Daglow; two players, up to 50 rounds of 30-120 s; gold buys houses, schools, factories, hospitals, forts, fishing and PT boats; income from factories, fishing boats over fish schools, and rain clouds over farms; rebels; hurricanes and tropical storms; pirates.
